svg.text: Effective-cavity LA PV is a shadow diagnostic axis, not acceptance; blood-volume PV remains the physiology-facing mass-ledger audit. This SVG hides rows unless blood-volume x-descent, v-loop area, immediate MV-opening downstroke, MV-opening transition, capacity/effective PV phase, and hidden-volume hygiene pass; non-opening C1/kink markers are visual warnings.
